topic: Climate change and catch potential in Viet Nam's EEZ
claim_a: DBEM (FAO 627, Table 4.1): minus 6.77% (RCP2.6) and minus 11.71% (RCP8.5) by 2050; minus 7.49% and minus 40.76% by 2100, relative to 2000 [SEC-07]
claim_b: Dynamic size-based food-web model (FAO 627, Table 4.2): minus 2.78% (RCP2.6) and minus 4.27% (RCP8.5) by 2050; 0.00% and minus 6.53% by 2100, relative to 2000 [SEC-07]
position_taken: Report both; do not average. To 2050 both models give a fall of 3 to 12%, smaller than the fall in standing stock since 2000 to 2005 (22.1%) and the policy cut in capture to 2030 (about 27%). After 2050 under RCP8.5 the sign is the same but the size differs sixfold; give no central figure.
notes: Each value is FAO's own average across driving climate models, with published ranges of about 9 to 15 points at mid-century.

topic: Imported soy protein embodied in meat protein
claim_a: ch22: replacing 1 t of meat protein avoids about 4.5 t of soybean meal (about 2.1 t of soy protein at 46%) [QNT model]
claim_b: This line: about 1.9 to 2.4 kg of soybean-meal protein per kg of pork protein and 3.4 kg per kg of poultry protein, from the same balance-model assumptions (sec_calc.py)
position_taken: Use ch22's 4.5 t for the national average; our species figures are an upper-side check. The difference comes from method: we apply whole-herd feed conversion to all feed and ignore imported meat and aquaculture in the mix.
notes: Not a substantive disagreement; logged so the two figures are not mixed.
